summary: TTM Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTMI) filed an 8-K on June 17, 2026, announcing definitive stock purchase agreements to acquire two privately-held European companies: Swiss Technology Group AG (Zurich) and ILFA GmbH (Hannover, Germany). Both transactions are for all-cash consideration, with no specific price per share, premium, or implied value disclosed. Regulatory approvals are required; the company expects to close subject to those conditions. The board recommends the acquisitions, but no advisor is named. The combined acquisitions would establish TTM's presence in Europe, adding PCB and materials capabilities in medical, aerospace/defense, and other markets. Investors should watch for regulatory clearance timing and potential integration risks; no break fee or deal mechanics details are provided.
